visualTraits: Large mouth extends behind the rear edge of the eye.
A dark horizontal stripe is often visible along the side.
lookAlikes: Compare mouth size and the side stripe with native black bass relatives before reporting.

disposalGuidance.text: Follow local authority and event directions; do not release a captured fish elsewhere.

visualTraits: Deep, laterally compressed body with a dark ear flap.
Vertical bars are usually visible on the sides.
lookAlikes: Compare the dark ear flap and vertical bars with native sunfish before reporting.

disposalGuidance.text: Follow local authority and event directions; do not release a captured fish elsewhere.

cookingGuidance.text: Only consume fish handled and prepared under current local food-safety guidance.

visualTraits: Fast-growing climbing vine with rough, broad leaves.
Small prickly fruits form in clusters.
lookAlikes: Check the clustered prickly fruit and vine before reporting; do not rely on an image alone.

disposalGuidance.text: Report the plant and follow local authority guidance before any removal or disposal.
